name: Haraka
description: Haraka is a high-performance, pluggable SMTP server built on Node.js. It supports inbound and outbound mail, a rich plugin ecosystem including SPF, DKIM, rspamd, ClamAV, and flexible queue backends such as smtp_forward, LMTP, and RabbitMQ.

notes.text: SMTP listens on port 2525 (non-privileged). Update your firewall/NAT rules accordingly.
Plugin selection is interactive during install — choose your use case (Inbound MTA, Outbound Relay, Spam Filtering, Antivirus, Monitoring) and plugins will be pre-selected automatically.
If rspamd or ClamAV are selected, they will be installed and configured inside the same container. ClamAV requires significant RAM — ensure the container has at least 2048 MB.
Some plugins (relay, dkim, auth, rcpt_to.in_host_list) require additional manual configuration after install. The installer will display a list of files that need attention.
